result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but several horizontally scrolling and lower-page elements appear clipped or obscured, making the layout feel unfinished.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right, with only a partial additional chip visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional overflow behavior and provide a clear scroll affordance, or constrain the row so partially visible chips do not look accidentally broken.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel extends beyond the viewport: the third card and its restaurant name are visibly truncated at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Implement a clearly scrollable carousel with appropriate clipping and spacing, or show fewer complete cards at this breakpoint.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is visibly covered by the fixed bottom navigation, so its content is cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page content equal to the navigation bar height so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The large gray circular control in the top-right contains only a small red notification dot and appears to be missing its expected icon or avatar content.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended profile, location, or notification icon inside the circle, or remove the empty circular container.
